$comment: Variant of settings.json for agents or teams WITHOUT the swarm plugin: it adds the hooks the plugin would run. The commands come from swarm.json -> hooks.sessionStart / hooks.stop / hooks.preEdit (the defaults below are the Node reference scripts; leases.ts check exits 2 only to refuse an edit in an exclusive zone another live session holds). If the repo has no such scripts (swarm.json has no hooks block), delete the SessionStart and Stop entries: a hook that points at a missing script only prints errors. Do not use this file together with the plugin: the hooks would run twice.

hooks.command: in=$(cat); f=$(printf '%s' "$in" | sed -n 's/.*"file_path"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1); case "$f" in *vitest.config.*|*jest.config.*|*biome.json|*architecture.test.*|*docs.test.*|*scripts/dev/land.*|*scripts/dev/verify.*|*quality-ratchets.json|*.githooks/*|*.github/workflows/*|*swarm.json|*.claude/settings.json) echo "Warning: you are touching a quality gate ($f). Explain why in the commit; never relax it to make something pass." >&2 ;; esac; exit 0
